# Docs

  - [How Mandate decides](/docs/how-mandate-decides)
  - API Reference
    - Automation: Zapier. Out: with `ZAPIER_HOOK_URL` set, Mandate posts an `AutomationEvent` to that Catch Hook for
every approval request, blocked purchase, payment, failed payment and mandate status change.
In: a Zap can pull the kill switch with `AUTOMATION_SECRET`. Automations can stop spending, never approve it.
      - [Pause, resume or revoke spending from an automation](/docs/api/openapi/automation/killSwitch): For a Zap such as "text STOP to pause every agent". Without `mandateId` it acts on all of the
user's mandates. Logged in the signed decision log as "via automation".
    - Demo: The buyer side of the demo. Single demo user, no login.
      - [Server status and which services are live or simulated](/docs/api/openapi/demo/getHealth): Which integrations this server is running with: real PayPal sandbox or simulated payments, the
model behind the agent, where data is stored, and whether Zapier alerts and the kill switch are on.
Always sandbox-only.
      - [The demo user's mandates](/docs/api/openapi/demo/listMandates): Every mandate the demo user has signed, with its rules and status (active, paused or revoked).
      - [Sign spending rules](/docs/api/openapi/demo/createMandate): With only `text`, the rules reader (the configured model, or the offline reader) turns the
sentence into a policy and Mandate signs it. With `policy`, the rules the user reviewed are
validated and signed. Rate limited when the model is called.
      - [Let the shopping agent carry out a task under a mandate](/docs/api/openapi/demo/runAgent): The agent can only search, read and propose. Each proposal goes through the policy gate, which
pays, asks the user, or blocks. With `stream: true` the response is NDJSON, one step per line.
      - [Purchases waiting for the user](/docs/api/openapi/demo/listApprovals): Purchases the gate sent to the user (over a soft limit), with when each request expires.
      - [Approve or decline a purchase](/docs/api/openapi/demo/decideApproval): If the user has a passkey, approving needs a WebAuthn assertion over this exact cart
(challenge from `GET /api/approvals/{id}/passkey`). Hard rules (category, seller, injected
instructions) can never be approved through.
    - Verification: Check an agent payment before you ship, or for a dispute. Public keys only, no trust in Mandate needed.
      - [Verdict for an agent payment](/docs/api/openapi/verification/verifyOrder): Is this PayPal order backed by a mandate the buyer signed? Returns the Mandate v1 checks
(Intent, Cart and Payment Mandates, Ed25519), the `paypal_order_record` check (PayPal's own
order record, read with the PayPal Server SDK, shows the signed amount captured), and the
AP2 v0.2 verdict in `ap2`.
Fulfil only when `ok` and `ap2.ok` are both true.
      - [AP2 v0.2 evidence pack for a PayPal order](/docs/api/openapi/verification/getAp2Evidence): The merchant-signed checkout JWT, the Checkout and Payment Mandate chains (SD-JWT, ES256),
the checkout and payment receipts, budget context, the passkey assertion if the buyer approved
on their device, and every check with its result. Verify independently with `/api/ap2/jwks`.
      - [A merchant's agent payments with their verdicts](/docs/api/openapi/verification/listSellerPayments): Every agent payment to a merchant, newest first, each with its Mandate v1 verdict and AP2 v0.2
result. A seller's queue of "safe to fulfil" and "don't ship" orders.
      - [Verify a Mandate v1 credential chain you hold](/docs/api/openapi/verification/verifyChain): Checks an Intent, Cart and Payment Mandate chain against the published keys.
    - Keys: Public keys for everything Mandate signs.
      - [ES256 public keys (JWKS) for every AP2 credential](/docs/api/openapi/keys/getAp2Jwks): Provider, agent, payment gateway, merchants and users. Look keys up by `kid`.
      - [All public keys, Mandate v1 (Ed25519 PEM) and AP2 v0.2 (JWKS)](/docs/api/openapi/keys/getTrust): The full trust bundle in one call: users' and merchants' Ed25519 keys (with each merchant's
verified status), the platform key, and the AP2 JWKS. Cache it to verify payments offline.
      - [Ed25519 public key that signs receipts and permits](/docs/api/openapi/keys/getReceiptPublicKey): The PEM public key for checking the `signature` on every receipt in the decision log.
    - Receipts: Mandate's signed, hash-chained decision log.
      - [The signed, hash-chained decision log](/docs/api/openapi/receipts/listReceipts): Every decision Mandate made, in order. Each receipt carries the hash of the one before it and an
Ed25519 signature, so any edit, insertion or deletion breaks the chain.
      - [Verify the server's own log](/docs/api/openapi/receipts/verifyServerLog): Re-checks every hash link and signature in the server's decision log.
      - [Verify a copy of the log you hold](/docs/api/openapi/receipts/verifyLogCopy): Names the first altered entry (`brokenAt`) and why.
  - Context Plugin
    - [Context Plugin](/docs/context-plugin): Give your AI coding assistant working knowledge of this API's SDKs.
  - SDKs
    - [SDKs](/docs/sdks): Client libraries for this API.
    - [TypeScript SDK](/docs/sdks/typescript): Install and start using the TypeScript SDK.
    - [Python SDK](/docs/sdks/python): Install and start using the Python SDK.
    - [C# SDK](/docs/sdks/csharp): Install and start using the C# SDK.
